item.title: claude-skills
item.description:
This repository bundles the following skills:

  • NestJS Expert: Skill for backend development with the NestJS framework.
  • React Expert: Skill for frontend development with React.
  • Feature Forge: Skill supporting feature-development workflows.
  • Architecture Designer: Skill for designing application architecture.
  • Test Master: Skill focused on writing and managing tests.
  • DevOps Engineer: Skill for DevOps and infrastructure tasks.
  • Debugging Wizard: Skill for investigating and fixing bugs.
  • Secure Code Guardian: Skill for hardening code against vulnerabilities.
